title: Dumcius drops 26 as Marijampoles SC cruise past Siauliai to clinch U19 Lithuanian Basketball League title
description: Marijampoles SC-Eurostandard claimed the U19 Lithuanian Basketball League championship on Saturday, overwhelming Siauliu KA "Saule" I-Å SG 95-76 in the final at their home arena on Gamyklu Street behind a devastating first-half performance. The hosts set the tone with a blistering opening quarter, racing to a 31-12 lead that effectively ended the contest before it had truly begun. title: Perkunas Kaunas celebrate U19 League title
description: Perkunas Kaunas clinched U19 League title. They outscored their cross-town rivals Zalgiris 83-76 in the championship game to conquer the trophy. Dominykas Grunkis (164-PG-2007) stepped up with 27 points to lead the champions. Perkunas limited their opponents to just 10 points in the first period to gain a 6-point lead. Zalgiris fired 21 points in the second frame to eke out a 31-30 halftime advantage. But Perkunas stepped on the gas in the second half. They unleashed 53 points in the second half to rally to the victory. Justas Juozaitis (201-F-2006) had 21 points in the win. Nedas Vydmantas (186-PG-2006) answered with 26 points for Zalgiris.
imageCaption: Perkunas Kaunas celebrate U19 League title (Photo: mlk.lt)

title: Panevezio SC/RSSG clinch U19 title
description: Panevezio SC/RSSG - Siauliai Saule 102-85 Panevezio SC/RSSG clinched U19 League title. They rallied past Siauliai Saule in the title game. Dominykas Simonis (2006) tallied 25 points and 14 rebounds to lead the charge. Panevezio grabbed a 56-47 halftime lead. They went on a 27-9 rally in the third term to clear off for good. Nikas Stuknys (200-G-2005) produced 22 points and 9 assists for the champions. Deividas Zukauskas (162-PG-2005) replied with 22 points for Siauliai.
imageCaption: Panevezio SC/RSSG clinch U19 title (Photo: mkl.lt)

title: Panevezio celebrate U19 League title
description: Panevezio captured U19 League title. They nipped V.Knasiaus KM 86-85 in the title game today. Nikas Stuknys (194-G-2005) came up with 24 points to pace the winners. VKKM led by as many as 8 points after the first period 26-18. They maintained the lead throughout the second term. VKKM entered the second period up by 9 points 48-39. But Panevezio turned things around in the second half. They ignited a 30-21 run in the third period to erase the deficit. Panevezio then limited their opponents to just 16 points in the fourth stanza and raced to the victory. Titas Kriksciunas (2004) posted 20 points for the champions. Kristupas Keinys (202-SF-2004) netted 21 points and grabbed 23 rebounds for VKKM. Rytis Sakaitis (193-PG-2004) added 19 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Panevezio celebrate U19 League title (Photo: mkl.lt)

title: V.Knasiaus KM claim MKL U19 title
description: V.Knasiaus KM celebrated the MKL U19 title. They beat Panevezio 86-83 in the Final game in Siauliai. Mintautas Mockus (201-G-2003) was unstoppable with 24 points and 19 rebounds for the champions. Panevezio dominated in the first half. They recorded a 43-38 halftime lead. Panevezio controlled the tempo throughout the third term. They entered the final period up by five points. But V.Knasiaus KM responded with a 21-13 rally in the fourth quarter to snatch the victory. Kristupas Keinys (199-SF-2004) tossed in 18 points in the win. Dominykas Butka (198-SG-2003) answered with 24 points and 9 rebounds for Panevezio.
imageCaption: V.Knasiaus KM claim MKL U19 title (Photo: mkl.lt)

title: Panevezio earn U19 League title
description: Panevezio celebrated U19 League title. They outscored Zalgiris 82-73 in the Final. Titas Matevicius (02) and Dovydas Butka (200-F-03) produced 19 points each for the champions. Panevezio grabbed a 20-15 lead after ten minutes. They dropped 21 points in the third term to secure a 6-point lead heading into the fourth quarter. Panevezio held Zalgiris to just 16 points in the final period and raced to the victory. Augustas Gaivenis (F-03) and Kristupas Kenesis (02) had 16 points each for the winners. Nedas Montvila (188-G-02) answered with 18 points for Zalgiris.
imageCaption: Panevezio earn U19 League title (Photo: Facebook)
